description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing batch processing tasks in a non-blocking, progressive manner, primarily for UI updates such as expanding tree nodes in a dashboard.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller to process items in batches asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, with start and cancel controls.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, managing UI state (running, progress, counts) and providing methods to start processing from items or cancel.
